text.description_html:
Acorn AZC208, Equality Absolute Zero Collection Cabinet Pull

The clean lines of this Acorn cabinet pull are sure to add a chic touch to your home. Sophisticated in design, this cabinet handle is a great way to add a cosmopolitan look to any home without looking as sterile as other contemporary designs can. This Equality stainless steel cabinet pull is a perfect example of how modern design doesn't have to focus on function rather than form. It has an adjustable center to center from 3" to 4", making installing this stainless steel kitchen cabinet pull easy. Available in polished stainless steel or brushed stainless steel finishes.

Also Available: Matching Kitchen Cabinet Knob

Specifications for the Acorn AZC208 Equality Cabinet Pull with Adjustable Center to Center:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Adjustable Center to Center from 3" to 4"
  • Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 1"
  • Projection: 1-1/16"
  • Available in polished stainless steel or brushed stainless steel.

Sold Individually
